title: When Safe Unimodal Inputs Collide: Optimizing Reasoning Chains for Cross-Modal Safety in Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as a subcategory of 'Ethical Safety' within the introduced SSUI dataset taxonomy and comprehensive safety benchmarks (e.g., MLLM-GUARD). Models are tested on their ability to maintain safe reasoning paths and avoid harmful outputs when presented with implicitly unsafe cross-modal inputs (innocuous image-text pairs that synergistically form biased or discriminatory scenarios).

Assessed under the 'Political controversies' subcategory of 'National Safety' in the SSUI dataset, evaluating the model's cross-modal reasoning chains and responses to politically sensitive multimodal inputs.

Evaluated as part of the 'Cultural/history' subcategory within the SSUI dataset's safety taxonomy, testing the model's reasoning alignment against cultural sensitivities using cross-modal image-text pairs.
